title: CmdPal: Honor the PowerToys language setting

status.label: Waiting for fork Copilot review
status.detail: The five-file upstream diff was mirrored exactly and a fresh Copilot review is outstanding. Phase 0 also identified an unresolved product-boundary question about whether Command Palette should follow PowerToys settings or Windows display language.

next_action: Consume the review requested at 2026-09-19T15:55:19Z without issuing a duplicate request, then combine its result with the maintainer product-direction decision.

phase0.detail: A collaborator stated that Command Palette is intentionally disconnected from PowerToys settings; the author asked whether Windows display language should remain authoritative and offered to close the PR.

fork_head.details: Restore passed, but runner compilation stopped during Visual Studio vcpkg initialization because inherited Git configuration referenced a missing GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_2. No PR-source compiler error was reported.

upstream_safety.detail: No public mutation was made to microsoft/PowerToys.
